title: Theme API docs executor
description: Extract the API of the theme layer of one framework (a flat package) from its TSDoc into ApiDoc JSON, one file per base component.

framework.description: The framework of the theme package.

outputDir.description: The output folder, relative to the workspace root. Its JSON files are replaced. Default: dist/api-docs/theme-<theme>/<framework>.

baseDir.description: The folder of the base ApiDoc files of the framework, which the theme parts are matched against.

tsConfig.description: The tsconfig of the package, relative to the workspace root.
